category: 微分方程 / 常微分方程
statement_blocker: The catalog does not define stiffness or select an equation class, state space, initial/boundary data, numerical method, grid, arithmetic model, analytic assumptions, error or stability notion, ordered binders, exact conclusion, constants, or degenerate cases. Choosing implicit Euler, a test equation, a Runge-Kutta or multistep/BDF result, or an A/L-stability theorem would substitute missing mathematics and collide with separately cataloged targets.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix scalar versus system ODE, real or complex state space and universes, autonomous or nonautonomous dynamics, initial or boundary data, time interval, norm and topology, and finite-dimensional or function-space structure.
conclusion: Open: the source names numerical solution of a topic but states no truth-valued property such as well-definedness, consistency, order, stability, convergence, an error bound, stiffness robustness, or complexity.
degenerate_case_status: No case is silently excluded before a proposition is selected; zero steps, empty/reversed intervals, zero modes, singular Jacobians, nonunique exact or implicit solutions, method-order boundaries, and stability-region boundaries require source-mapped decisions.
candidate_scope_not_credited: backward Euler on the Dahlquist scalar test equation
A-stability or L-stability of an implicit one-step method
stability and convergence of an implicit Runge-Kutta method
zero-stability, consistency, convergence, or a barrier theorem for linear multistep methods
stability or convergence of a backward differentiation formula
a source-specific trajectory error bound for a discrete approximation
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1476 stiff stability, THM-M-1477 A-stability, and THM-M-1478 L-stability
the scalar Dahlquist test equation, implicit Euler, or another convenient special case used as the unidentified general target
a numerical experiment, benchmark, plot, floating-point run, or definition of stiffness used as theorem evidence
generic ODE existence, uniqueness, trajectory comparison, or Gronwall infrastructure treated as a numerical-method theorem
a structure field or hypothesis that assumes the requested method correctness, stability, convergence, or error conclusion
the untrusted catalog label 已验证 treated as human-source or kernel evidence

foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory is intended; classical logic, choice, completeness, spectral/functional analysis, quotient, and noncomputability policies remain open because no proposition has been selected
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports, terminal declarations, transitive dependency closure, axioms, and trust policy remain open
computation_profile: No floating-point solver, nonlinear iteration, tolerance decision, experiment, oracle, generated certificate, native computation, or external CAS result is credited; exact computation policy awaits the source proposition
formal_system: Lean 4 + pinned mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source or target correction, stiffness definition, ODE class, state/time/data model, numerical method, grid, arithmetic, solver, tolerance, regularity, spectrum/Jacobian, norm, stability/error/convergence conclusion, boundary decision, Lean target, toolchain or dependency pin, assurance profile, validator, or any owned artifact change; independent reviewers and master acceptance remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. H5 classifies the catalog topic and numerical-solution gloss as not yet a stable proposition; it does not refute correctly stated stiff-equation results. The historical citation and pinned API probe are discovery evidence only. No canonical statement, H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, theorem completion, or master acceptance is claimed.
